description: The Kerstcross Opmeer is a sporting and atmospheric cross-country running event held annually on Boxing Day in Opmeer. With a rich tradition and more than 2,200 participants, young and old, the Kerstcross offers challenging courses beside the VVS’46 grounds, with the start and finish on the A-field. The race is part of the Noord-Hollands Crosskampioenschap and is known for its warm atmosphere, professional chip timing, and personal touch, with names printed on race numbers. After the event, all participants receive a memento and can watch the finish video online.

The prize-giving takes place outdoors immediately after the finish, on the A-field grandstand. All 800-meter runners receive a water bottle at the finish. Hot showers and changing rooms are available. Dogs are not allowed on the land. Distances: 5 km and 10 km, including the Noord-Hollands Crosskampioenschap; the event also includes a walking tour and prize money.

description: The Třtice Christmas Run is a traditional running race held annually on December 26 in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long, with categories based on age and gender. This popular sporting event continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. It is part of the village’s sporting activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40–49 years), C (50–59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run held since 1976
additional: The race uses the same categories as the summer Třtická Punčocha run. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the village website. Třtice offers sports facilities, including a children’s playground and a multi-purpose sports court. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, and is attended by approximately 200 runners. The course is around 4.8 km long, with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for the general public and fosters a festive Christmas sporting atmosphere.

name: Internationaler Sparverein Silvesterlauf Saarbrücken
description: Der Internationale Sparverein Silvesterlauf Saarbrücken ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf zum Jahresabschluss, der am 27. Dezember 2026 im Sportcampus Saar stattfindet. Die Hauptdistanz ist ein amtlich vermessener 10-km-Rundkurs, der größtenteils durch den Saarbrücker Stadtwald führt und Start sowie Ziel im Stadion des Sportcampus hat. Neben dem Hauptlauf gibt es weitere Wettbewerbe für Schüler und Kinder auf flachen Rundkursen. Der Lauf zieht jährlich zahlreiche Teilnehmer und Zuschauer an und bietet eine besondere Atmosphäre mit sportlichen Highlights und attraktiven Preisen.
course_highlights: 10-km-Rundkurs mit Start und Ziel im Stadion des Sportcampus Saar
Strecke führt größtenteils durch den Saarbrücker Stadtwald
Flache Rundkurse für Schüler- und Kinderläufe
additional: Nachmeldungen sind online bis zum 27.12. um 10:00 Uhr möglich sowie vor Ort am 27.12. von 15:00 bis 17:00 Uhr und am 28.12. ab 10:30 Uhr bis eine Stunde vor dem jeweiligen Start. Vor Ort ist nur Barzahlung möglich. Parken ist kostenlos im Parkhaus der Universität des Saarlandes, ca. 5 Minuten Fußweg zum Startbereich. Urkunden können online unter www.meisterchip.de ausgedruckt werden. Es gibt Pokale und Gutscheine für die Erstplatzierten in verschiedenen Wertungsklassen sowie Medaillen für Kinderläufe. Lauf im Winter, kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten im Parkhaus der Universität des Saarlandes, Nachmeldung vor Ort nur bar möglich

name: Keiloop
description: The Keiloop is an annual running event organized by Sportclub Meddo, taking place for the 39th time in 2026. The event offers five different distances: 1, 3, 5, 10 and 15 kilometers, suitable for a range of abilities and ages. It takes place in Winterswijk Meddo and is known as a cherished tradition in the local sporting community. The organizers also welcome volunteers to help make the event a success.
course_highlights: Five distances: 1, 3, 5, 10 and 15 km
Organized by Sportclub Meddo in Winterswijk Meddo
Annual event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race is held annually and has a loyal group of participants. Registration is available via the official website. The event takes place in winter, around Christmas, and offers a great opportunity for a sporting activity in the Achterhoek.

name: Kerstloop Amstelveen
description: The Kerstloop Amstelveen is a festive running race held in the beautiful Amsterdamse Bos. The routes are mostly traffic-free and offer an enjoyable running experience for young and old alike. With distances of 2.5 km for youth, 5 km for fast runners, and a headline distance of 10 km, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. After the race, all participants receive a medal and can enjoy a fresh oliebol. Organizers AV Startbaan and Roda Conditie warmly welcome everyone for an active and enjoyable day.
course_highlights: Routes mostly through the Amsterdamse Bos
Traffic-free course
Free parking at the start
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:00 at RODA’23. Timing is done using a chip attached to the race number, which must not be folded. After the race, every participant receives a fresh oliebol and a medal. The top three finishers in each distance receive a cup, and there is a €50 prize for breaking the 10 km course record. On-the-day payment is accepted only in exact cash or by QR code; card payments are not accepted. Routes through the Amsterdamse Bos, advance registration recommended, electronic timing, parking at the sports complex, changing and shower facilities

name: 33e Physique 3de Kerstdagloop
description: The Physique Derde Kerstdagloop in Arnhem is a scenic running race held on Sunday, 27 December 2026. The main event is the 21.1 km half marathon, known as one of the most beautiful and toughest half marathons in the Netherlands, with a challenging course through forests and heathland. There are also 14 km and 7 km distances, which run partly on unpaved paths and hilly terrain. The race is organised at Sportcentrum Valkenhuizen and offers facilities such as changing rooms, showers and secure baggage storage. Timing uses the Ipico system, and there are water stations on the longer distances.
course_highlights: 21.1 km half-marathon course with 185 metres of elevation gain through forests and heathland
14 km route with more than 50% unpaved paths and a fast start over hills and avenues
7 km course featuring a forest section, plenty of climbing and descending, and the notorious ‘Geitenbult’
additional: Changing rooms, showers and free secure baggage storage are available. First aid is available. Timing uses an Ipico chip, which must be returned after the race (unreturned chips cost 10 euros). There are water stations at 8 and 17 km for the half marathon and at 10 km for the 14 km race. Volunteers are members of Ciko’66. The finish is on the Ciko’66 track. Routes through forests and heathland, car-free cycle paths, changing rooms, first aid, sports massages, limited parking; public transport is recommended.

description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Blijham is an annual running event organized by Aquilo Athletics Club. The event attracts more than 1,000 runners and walkers and starts and finishes at the ASVB parking lot. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge at the end of the year. The organizers provide a well-run and safe race environment for all participants.

After a two-year hiatus, the race is once again looking forward to welcoming participants, who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and sportsmanship.

Routes of 6.2 km and 3.1 km are available
The race is part of a traditional year-end celebration with a Christmas-season atmosphere
additional: The race starts and finishes in Lysá nad Labem. It is a traditional annual event that promotes sporting activity in the community.

description: Der Aschauer Vorsilvesterlauf ist eine beliebte Laufveranstaltung in Aschau im Chiemgau, die seit 2009 vom Verein Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. und dem Gewerbeverein Aschau e.V. organisiert wird. Mit einer flachen und schnellen 5-km-Strecke durch den Ortskern sowie einem Kinderlauf über 1,7 km bietet der Lauf sowohl Hobby- als auch Leistungsläufern ein attraktives Rennen. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt als Südbayerns größte Laufparty zwischen den Jahren und zieht jährlich zahlreiche Teilnehmer und Zuschauer an. Neben sportlichem Ehrgeiz steht auch die Gemeinschaft und der Spaß im Vordergrund, unterstützt durch ein vielfältiges Rahmenprogramm und eine Afterrun-Party.
course_highlights: Flache, schnelle 5-km-Strecke durch den Ortskern von Aschau
Kinderlauf über eine Runde von 1,7 km
Drei Runden im Hobby- und Nachtlauf, insgesamt 5 km
additional: Startnummernausgabe am 27.12.2025 ab 17 Uhr im Chalet Aschau. Leihchips für Zeitnahme werden ausgegeben und müssen bis 21 Uhr zurückgegeben werden, sonst 30 € Gebühr. Im Zielbereich gibt es Glühwein (auch alkoholfrei), Lebkuchen und Stollen. Jeder Finisher erhält eine essbare Medaille. Nach dem Nachtlauf findet eine Siegerehrung und Afterrun-Party im Chalet statt. Parkplätze sind an Festhalle, Touristinformation, Sporthalle und Bahnhof vorhanden. Umkleiden und Toiletten sind im Roten Kreuz-Heim und Bahnhof verfügbar. 5 km Lauf, Kinderlauf, Gemeinschaftsveranstaltung, jährlich am 28. Dezember, festliche Stimmung, Medaillen und Verpflegung inklusive

name: Drenthe Trail Run
price_range: 7 km: €25,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 18 km: €36,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 26 km: €42,50 + €1 administratiekosten
description: The Drenthe Trail Run is a winter trail run taking place on 29 December 2026 in Norg. Participants can choose from three distances: 7, 18 or 26 kilometres, which wind through the forests, heathland and unpaved trails of Drenthe. The event celebrates experiencing nature, adventure and a friendly atmosphere, with a varied course suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The start and finish are in Norg, and time slots are used to ensure the course remains calm and safe.
course_highlights: A varied course through forests, sandy roads and trails
Routes of 7, 18 and 26 km through Drenthe’s most beautiful natural areas
A winter trail focused on nature and adventure
additional: Time slots are used for each distance to keep the course calm and safe. Participants receive individual timekeeping and have their first name printed on their race bib. Aid stations offer snacks, sports nutrition and water; participants are asked to bring their own cup for sustainability reasons. First aid and technical support are available at the start/finish. After the finish, there will be food, drinks, music and a friendly atmosphere. A bag-drop area is available for dry clothes. Trail shoes are recommended. Registration opens on 17 June 2023 at 08:00, with time slots used to ensure safety and keep the course calm. The event highlights outdoor adventure, respect for nature and a friendly atmosphere.

description: The Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Run is a unique evening race in the atmospherically lit Soester Dunes. Participants can choose to run up to three laps of 1,300 metres each through a beautifully decorated forest and dune area, following the official Sylvestercross course. The finish is at the familiar location, offering a preview of the big Sylvestercross day. Alongside the run, there is also a Family Run for children and a walking tour, making the event suitable for the whole family. Get ready for a magical evening full of fun and a special running experience.
course_highlights: Run through a beautifully lit forest and dune area
Official Sylvestercross course
Finish at the familiar location in the Soester Dunes
additional: Participants can order an LED foam stick when registering and collect it along with their race number. The walking tour starts at 18:30 and is one lap of 1.3 km. The Family Run is specifically for children aged 5 to 15 and starts at 19:00. The course is difficult to navigate with strollers and walkers. The run offers a magical evening, with various experience points along the course. Decorations, optional foam stick, registration with the option to enter the originality prize, start and finish in the dunes, donation to the Prinses Maxima Centrum Foundation.

name: AH Oudejaars Crossloop Vorden
location: Het Grote Veld, Vorden, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The AH Oudejaars Crossloop in Vorden takes place on Wednesday, December 30, and offers a scenic run along the forest trails and sandy paths of the Het Grote Veld nature reserve. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 km, and there is a special 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4 to 12. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere, with coffee, tea, and oliebollen after the race, and prizes in various categories. Registration is open until December 27 at 18:00, after which participants will receive their race numbers.
course_highlights: Run along forest trails and sandy paths in the Het Grote Veld nature reserve
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 km available
A 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4–12
additional: The entry fee includes coffee or tea and an oliebol after the race. Kids’ cross participants receive squash drink, an oliebol, and a medal. The race number with a timing chip is emailed the day before the race and can be collected up to half an hour before the start. Registration on race day is not possible. Registration is open from mid-September until December 27 at 18:00. The event attracts many participants from the region and is known for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: Der Silvesterlauf Bremen ist ein beliebtes Lauf-Event am 31. Dezember, das Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus willkommen heißt. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von 400 m für Bambinis bis hin zu 10 km für erfahrene Läufer, die durch die schöne Umgebung am Werdersee führen. Neben dem sportlichen Jahresabschluss sorgt festliche Musik und Silvesterstimmung für ein besonderes Erlebnis. Verkleidete Teilnehmer sind herzlich eingeladen, das Event kreativ mitzugestalten und gemeinsam ins neue Jahr zu laufen.
course_highlights: Strecken führen durch die malerische Umgebung am Werdersee
Barriereärmere 2,5 km Strecke für Einsteiger und Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen
Festliche Silvesterstimmung mit Musik und Medaillen für alle Finisher
additional: Startzeiten variieren je Strecke: 5 km Lauf um 12:00 Uhr, 2,5 km Walking um 12:30 Uhr, 5 km und 10 km Walking um 12:50 Uhr, Bambinilauf 400 m um 12:55 Uhr, Kidsrun 1000 m um 13:00 Uhr, 10 km Lauf um 13:15 Uhr. Versand der Startunterlagen gegen Gebühr möglich. Barriereärmere 2,5 km Strecke für alle geeignet. Verkleidung ist ausdrücklich erwünscht für ein besonderes Silvester-Feeling. verschiedene Strecken, inklusive Kinder- und Walking-Optionen, festliche Atmosphäre, Medaillen für alle, kreative Verkleidungen erlaubt

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: Der Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hannover ist ein traditioneller Jahresabschlusslauf, der am 31. Dezember stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet einen 7,7 km langen Rundkurs, der überwiegend auf asphaltierten Wegen durch die Steintormasch, zur Wasserkunst und am Stichkanal entlang bis zur Ihme führt. Der Lauf startet um 13:00 Uhr beim Vereinsheim des Hannoverschen Radsportclubs am Weddigenufer. Nach dem Lauf können sich die Teilnehmer bei Glühwein und Bratwurst stärken und erhalten ein Finisher-Weizenbierglas als Erinnerung. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt für ihre gemütliche Atmosphäre und den Massenstart.
course_highlights: 7,7 km Rundkurs auf überwiegend asphaltierten Wegen
Strecke führt durch die Steintormasch zur Wasserkunst und zum Stichkanal
Start und Ziel am Vereinsheim des Hannoverschen Radsportclubs am Weddigenufer
additional: Massenstart, Glühwein und Bratwurst zu kleinen Preisen nach dem Lauf, jeder Finisher erhält ein Weizenbierglas 0,5l im Veranstaltungsdesign, Nachmeldungen am Veranstaltungstag ab 12:00 Uhr vor Ort möglich (Bar- oder Paypalzahlung). Der Lauf findet am 31. Dezember statt, mit online Anmeldung bis 31.12.25 10:00 Uhr. Es gibt Massenstart und Festivitäten, die den Lauf zu einem geselligen Jahresabschluss machen.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: Der 49. Wernigeröder Silvesterlauf ist der krönende Jahresabschluss im Harzkreis für alle Laufenthusiasten. Der Lauf findet am 31. Dezember 2026 am Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode statt und bietet eine festliche Atmosphäre zum Jahresausklang. Organisiert vom Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., ist dieser Lauf eine beliebte Veranstaltung für Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel am historischen Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Lauf durch die malerische Altstadt von Wernigerode
Festliche Stimmung zum Jahresabschluss im Harzkreis
additional: Strecke führt um das Wernigeröder Schloss, Start und Ziel am Marstall, keine Duschmöglichkeit, mehrere Events inklusive Nachwuchswettkämpfe und Trainingsangebote

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: Der Burgwedeler Silvesterlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die jährlich am 31. Dezember in Burgwedel stattfindet. Die Läufe führen über verschiedene Distanzen, darunter 10,6 km, 5,3 km und 2 km für Kinder, und bieten eine schöne Strecke mit Start und Ziel im modernisierten Stadion auf der Ramhorst. Die Veranstaltung zieht zahlreiche Läufer und Zuschauer an und wird vom Schwimmverein Burgwedel organisiert. Sie ist ein beliebter sportlicher Jahresabschluss mit familiärer Atmosphäre und vielfältigen Teilnehmergruppen.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel im frisch modernisierten Stadion auf der Ramhorst
Streckenlängen: 10,6 km, 5,3 km und 2 km Kinderlauf
Schöne blaue Laufbahn im Stadion
additional: Der Startschuss erfolgt pünktlich um 12:00 Uhr durch den Ortsbürgermeister. Die Veranstaltung findet traditionell auf der Ramhorst statt, wo die Serie 1984 begann. Es gibt eine Wertung für die größte Gruppe, und die Veranstaltung wird von zahlreichen Helfern, Sponsoren und Zuschauern unterstützt. Distanzen: 2 km, 5,3 km, 10 km; Wetter im Dezember meist kalt und schneebedeckt; Veranstaltung mit lokalen Vereinen, Feuerwehren und Familien; Streckenrekorde wurden aufgestellt.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: Der Silvesterlauf am Salzgittersee ist ein traditionsreiches Laufevent, das am letzten Tag des Jahres stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Lauf- und Walkingstrecken für unterschiedliche Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus. Der Lauf ist ein sportliches Highlight und Treffpunkt für Läufer und Zuschauer, die gemeinsam das Jahr sportlich ausklingen lassen möchten. Neben dem sportlichen Wettbewerb gibt es eine Teamwertung und eine Siegerehrung, die besonders die Kinderläufe würdigt.
course_highlights: Laufstrecken am Salzgittersee mit 5,7 km und 11,4 km
Kinderlauf über 1,2 km für Jahrgänge 2013 bis 2019
Teamwertung mit Addition der drei schnellsten Zeiten pro Team
additional: Startnummernabholung und Nachmeldungen (zzgl. 3 €) vom 16.12. bis 28.12.2025 an der Kasse des Stadtbades Salzgitter. Umschreibungen und Nachmeldungen am 30.12. (15-17 Uhr) und 31.12. (11-13 Uhr) im Foyer Stadtbad möglich. Online-Anmeldung bis 31.12.25 um 10:00 Uhr ohne extra Gebühr, sofern nicht ausgebucht. Teamwertung mit Addition der drei schnellsten Zeiten pro Team. Startunterlagen müssen nicht persönlich abgeholt werden. Anmeldung online bis 31.12.25, Startnummernabholung im Stadtbad Salzgitter, Verpflegung im Zielbereich, Parkmöglichkeiten am Salzgittersee, Hunde und Laufwägen erlaubt

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: Der Silvesterlauf Magdeburg ist ein traditionsreicher Volkssportlauf, der seit über 50 Jahren am letzten Tag des Jahres stattfindet. Er verbindet Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus in der Stadt Magdeburg. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt für ihre familiäre Atmosphäre und den sportlichen Jahresabschluss, bei dem über 900 Teilnehmer die Ziellinie überqueren. Der Lauf ist Teil der Magdeburger Stadtrangliste und erfreut sich großer Beliebtheit in der Region.
course_highlights: 5 km Runde, die zweimal durchlaufen wird
10 km Distanz als Hauptlauf
1,5 km Kinderlauf für die jüngsten Teilnehmer
additional: Der Silvesterlauf ist der abschließende, achte Wettkampf der Magdeburger Stadtrangliste. Über 950 kleine und große Läuferinnen und Läufer nehmen teil. Die Veranstaltung wird vom Verein Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. organisiert. Strecken, Anmeldung, Ergebnisse, Fotos, Presseberichte; Wetter im Dezember meist kalt und schneereich

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: Der Berliner Silvesterlauf am 31. Dezember bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern die Möglichkeit, das Jahr sportlich ausklingen zu lassen. Die Veranstaltung führt auf drei verschiedenen Strecken (4 km, 6 km und 10 km) durch den malerischen Grunewald mit anspruchsvollen Abschnitten wie dem Drachen- und Teufelsberg, die mit tollen Aussichten über Berlin belohnen. Neben dem sportlichen Erlebnis steht der Spaß im Vordergrund, insbesondere durch die Möglichkeit, verkleidet zu laufen und die Prämierung der schönsten Kostüme. Im Ziel erwartet alle Finisher ein leckerer Pfannkuchen als süße Erinnerung zum Umhängen.
course_highlights: Streckenführung durch den Grunewald mit Drachenflieger- und Teufelsberg
Wahnsinns-Aussicht über ganz Berlin vor dem Jahreswechsel
Vielfältige Streckenlängen: 4 km, 6 km und 10 km
additional: Start und Ziel befinden sich in der Nähe des Mommsenstadions (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). Startpass und Startnummer werden vorab per E-Mail zugeschickt. Startunterlagen können am Veranstaltungstag ab 10:00 Uhr vor Ort abgeholt werden. Zeitmessung erfolgt mit Einweg-Transponder auf der Startnummer. Zeitlimit beträgt 1:30 Stunden. Im Ziel gibt es Wasser, Tee und Pfannkuchen. Es werden ausschließlich Mehrwegbecher verwendet. Umkleidemöglichkeiten sind im Mommsenstadion vorhanden, jedoch keine Kleiderabgabe. Ergebnisse und Urkunden sind am Abend online abrufbar. Strecken variieren zwischen 2, 4, 6 und 10 km; Lauf für alle Altersgruppen; Start und Ziel am Mommsenstadion; inklusive Verpflegung mit Pfannkuchen und Ehrungen für die besten Platzierungen sowie originelle Kostüme.

name: Silvesterlauf München
description: Der MRRC Silvesterlauf München ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung im Olympiapark München, die jährlich am 31. Dezember stattfindet. Mit über 4.300 Teilnehmern aus 54 Nationen zählt der Silvesterlauf zu den größten Silvesterläufen Deutschlands. Die Läufe führen auf Rundkursen durch den Olympiapark mit Start und Ziel am Seeufer nahe dem Olympiaturm. Die Veranstaltung bietet Strecken für alle Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus und sorgt für einen sportlichen und stimmungsvollen Jahresausklang.
course_highlights: Rundkurse durch den Olympiapark München
Start und Ziel am Seeufer nahe dem Olympiaturm
10-km-Lauf DLV-vermessen und bestenlistentauglich
additional: Startnummernausgabe am 30.12. von 17 bis 19 Uhr und am Veranstaltungstag ab 9:30 Uhr. Startnummer mit QR-Code ist gut sichtbar auf der Brust zu tragen. Sicherheitsnadeln werden gestellt. Pacemaker sind beim 5- und 10-km-Lauf im Einsatz. Start und Ziel sind am Seeufer nahe dem Olympiaturm. Es sind keine Nachmeldungen möglich. Startplatzumschreibung bis 23.12.2025 gegen Gebühr möglich. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und Fahrrad werden für die Anfahrt empfohlen. Jährliche Teilnehmerzahlen zwischen 1600 und über 2900, inklusive Ergebnisse, Fotos und Videos, Anmeldung online möglich

name: Silvesterlauf Neuss
description: Der Silvesterlauf Neuss ist ein etablierter 10-km-Lauf, der am 31. Dezember 2026 um 12 Uhr am Uedesheimer Deichtor startet. Die Strecke führt mit schönem Rheinblick durch die Rheinauen und Uedesheimer Felder und bietet so einen perfekten sportlichen Jahresabschluss. Das Laufevent ist für alle Läufer geeignet, vom Anfänger bis zum Profi, und verbindet sportliche Herausforderung mit einer festlichen Jahresabschlussatmosphäre. Zudem unterstützt der Lauf die Aktion Luftballon, den Förderverein der Kinderklinik im Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss, durch Spendensammlungen.
course_highlights: 10 km Strecke mit DLV-Genehmigung
Start am Uedesheimer Deichtor mit Rheinblick

Die familiäre Atmosphäre und die professionelle Organisation machen den Silvesterlauf zu einem beliebten Event, das mit Musik, Verpflegung und einer besonderen Stimmung zum Jahresausklang einlädt.

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: Der Nellschützer Silvester-Lauf ist ein traditionsreicher 10 km Straßenlauf in Lützen, Sachsen-Anhalt, der am Morgen des 31. Dezember stattfindet. Seit dem Jahr 2000 ist er ein fester Bestandteil des lokalen Laufkalenders und bietet einen gemeinschaftlichen Jahresabschluss für Läufer im Burgenlandkreis. Der Lauf startet in der Nähe der Kirche in Nellschütz und ist offiziell im deutschen Leichtathletik-Rahmen organisiert, inklusive Versicherung und Terminabstimmung. Charakteristisch ist der lockere Laufstil, bei dem meist in kleinen Gruppen gelaufen und geplaudert wird, statt auf Bestzeit zu laufen. Nach dem Lauf erwartet die Teilnehmer traditionell warmes Essen, Tee und Glühwein auf dem Hof der Familie Kitze.
course_highlights: 10 km Straßenlauf durch Lützen und Umgebung
Eigene Verpflegungsstelle auf der Strecke
Zielbereich mit warmem Essen, Tee und Glühwein auf dem Hof der Familie Kitze
additional: Typisches Wetter im Dezember: ca. 3 °C, Tiefsttemperatur -2 °C, meist schneebedeckt mit durchschnittlich 40 mm Niederschlag. Der Lauf ist als gemeinschaftlicher Jahresabschluss konzipiert, bei dem in kleinen Gruppen gelaufen wird. Start ist in der Nähe der Kirche in Nellschütz. Der Lauf startet in Nellschütz in der Nähe der Kirche, mit einer eigenen Verpflegungsstelle auf der Strecke. Das Event ist als Jahresabschlusslauf mit familiärer Atmosphäre bekannt.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: Der Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf zum Jahresausklang in Pulsnitz, Sachsen. Er bietet mit einem Kinderlauf über 1,2 km, einem Volkslauf über 4,8 km und einer Langstrecke über 9,2 km ein sportliches Menü für alle Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus. Der Lauf ist ein beliebtes Event für Läufer und Zuschauer und findet stets am Silvestertag statt, um das Jahr sportlich zu verabschieden. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre und engagierte Organisatoren aus.
course_highlights: Kinderlauf über 1,2 km
Volkslauf über 4,8 km
Langstrecke über 9,2 km
additional: Der Lauf findet traditionell am 31. Dezember statt und umfasst drei Distanzen für verschiedene Altersgruppen. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt für ihre familiäre Atmosphäre und den sportlichen Jahresabschluss. Es gibt keine Hinweise auf Startzeiten oder Preisstaffelungen auf der Website. Die Organisatoren sorgen für eine angenehme Laufumgebung mit Glühwein und einer Turnhalle als Treffpunkt. Startzeiten am 31.12.2025 um 13:10, 13:50 und 14:00 Uhr; Anmeldung vor Ort möglich; Laufstrecken: 1,2 km Kinderlauf, 4,8 km Volkslauf, 9,2 km Langstrecke; Verpflegung durch Vereinsmitglieder.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: Der OTB Silvesterlauf in Osnabrück ist ein traditioneller Jahresabschlusslauf, der Hobbyläufer, Walker und ambitionierte Athleten gleichermaßen anspricht. Am letzten Tag des Jahres können die Teilnehmer aus verschiedenen Strecken wählen, darunter ein Hauptlauf über 10 km, Walking-Strecken, eine Kurzstrecke über 5,6 km, einen barrierefreien Jedermannslauf sowie einen Bambini-Lauf. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine stimmungsvolle Atmosphäre und eine moderne Zeitmessung mit Einweg-Chip. Der Lauf führt durch landschaftlich reizvolle Abschnitte wie den Rubbenbruchsee und das Natruper Holz und ist seit 1980 eine feste Größe im Osnabrücker Laufkalender.
course_highlights: 10 km Hauptlauf führt zum Rubbenbruchsee, durch das Natruper Holz und über den Finkenhügel zurück zur Illoshöhe

Spikes sind auf den 10 km und 5,6 km Strecken nicht erlaubt. name: Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf
description: Der Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf ist eine traditionelle Laufveranstaltung in Ottenbach, die jährlich zum Jahresende stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern verschiedener Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam sportlich aktiv zu sein und das Jahr mit einem sportlichen Highlight abzuschließen. Die Strecken führen durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung von Ottenbach und bieten abwechslungsreiche Laufbedingungen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Ottenbach organisiert und ist ein beliebter Treffpunkt für die regionale Laufszene.

description: The Oliebollenloop is the final sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on 31 December in and around Gorredijk. The race offers 4-mile and 10 km distances, with separate starts for solo runners and businesses. There is also a kids’ run with three distances for different age groups. The route is safe from traffic and well marked, and a delicious reward awaits afterwards: oliebollen.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event takes place over two days, with atmospheric Sylvester by Night runs on 30 December and various fun runs and official races on 31 December, including cross-country races for different age groups and ability levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course features challenging routes through dunes and woodland, with special loops for young runners and recreational runners, as well as a new 21.5 km trail run.
course_highlights: Course in the Lange Duinen of Soest, through dunes and woodland

additional: The Sylvestercross includes various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a relay cross-country race and a G-cross. The relay cross-country race is a team event with 4 participants, each running one 1,900-metre loop. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross-Country Circuit and gives athletes the opportunity to earn points in the World Athletics rankings. Various distances and categories, including a night run and relays; event on 30 and 31 December 2026; registration available via the website.

The course is approximately 5.2 km long, and registration is available online at naZávody.cz. The event is traditionally associated with celebrating the arrival of the new year.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Park im. Jana Kasprowicza, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczecin New Year's Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 in Szczecin, by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children's races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia
The start and finish are by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: The race office is open on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30, where race numbers can be collected. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are located in the start area by the Summer Theatre. Capacity: 470 participants for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 for the Children's Races. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Nordic Walking and the Main Run each consist of two 2.5 km loops. Children's races are divided into three age-group heats, with distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. The program also includes Nordic Walking events over two 2.5 km loops and children's races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation. They take place in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. The activity is for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and partially sighted participants. The series includes a variety of courses with different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and partially sighted participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card. A special final badge is available upon completing the entire series. Courses are tailored to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former manor farm. Information about a specific edition on December 31, 2026, is not provided in the available materials.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026. As part of the event, a 5 km road race will be held, giving masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city's scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a chance for the athletics community to come together. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this prestigious event.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic city routes suited to fast times
An event accompanying the 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships
additional: Details of the date and event may change.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

name: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczn...
distance_verbose: Maraton, 35 km, 28 km, Półmaraton, 14 km, 7 km
description: The 20th Anniversary Silesian New Year’s Cyborg Marathon takes place in Silesian Park in Chorzów and invites participants to start the year actively. Participants can choose a distance from 7 km to the marathon, covering one to six 7 km loops. The program also includes a Nordic Walking half marathon. The start is scheduled by the Silesian Park administration building.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop in Silesian Park
Choose from one to six loops, up to the marathon distance
Nordic Walking half marathon over three loops
additional: The start is at 12:00 by the Silesian Park administration building. Participants could change the number of loops during the race; the time limit for the marathon was 360 minutes.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer IJsclub during the Limmer Kermis. The race attracts both children and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course passes through, among other places, the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race starts in the morning, with the youngest children setting off at 10:00 and adults at 10:30. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Starts during the Limmer Kermis in Limmen
additional: Registration is handled via email confirmation. After confirmation, the site administrator will get in touch. There are separate start times for children and adults. The organizer is the Limmer IJsclub, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Kermis and is known for its small-scale, welcoming atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a race bib including a commemorative cup, and registration is open until December 28.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg that has marked the athletic start of the new year for more than 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, combining paved and unpaved paths. The event is suitable for recreational runners and experienced athletes alike, with several distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn spirit.
course_highlights: Routes through Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
A mix of paved and unpaved paths
The private ‘Ravensloot’ path is accessible exclusively during the event
additional: Chip timing by ChronoRace; results can be followed live on the website and social media; race bibs can be collected on the day before the start at De Grift Sports Park; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money are available; multiple start times by distance (5 km starts at 13:00, 10 km starts at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route at the sports park in Woudenberg.

description: The Nieuwjaarsloop De Wilp is a welcoming running event held annually in the picturesque village of De Wilp. With distances ranging from a youth run to a half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route passes through the beautiful Groningen-Frisian countryside, with wide-open views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly, sporty character, bringing runners and spectators together to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque Groningen-Frisian countryside
Start and finish at the former church on Plantsoen
Aid stations along the route offering sports drink, tea, water and fruit
additional: Registration is open until 3 January at 23:59 via the website, or from 11:45 until half an hour before the start in the canteen of v.v. De Wilper Boys. Collect your race number no later than 15 minutes before the start. Parking is available in the v.v. De Wilper Boys car park near the canteen. First aid is available at the start/finish and from a mobile team along the route. Refreshments include sports drink, tea, water and fruit. Results and a finish video will be available. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; advance registration; winter conditions; youth and adults; parking near the sports club; first aid available; memento and refreshments included.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The Nieuwjaarsloop is organised by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race number. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. A discounted combined entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race number and a prize draw. The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.
course_highlights: Run through Sportpark Pelzer
Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg in ’t Veld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus 16 km walking
Coffee stop for walkers at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel
additional: Race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday evening before the race or on race day. Timing is recorded using a MyLaps chip in the race number; personal chips are not permitted. Volunteer traffic marshals accompany the race. Participation is at your own risk, and traffic rules must be followed. Walkers can stop for coffee at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel. Immediately after finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert. The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

name: Midwintercross Heeten
location: Sportpark SV Heeten, Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Midwintercross in Heeten is a regional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and is organised by SV Heeten. The 54th edition takes place on Sunday, 3 January 2027, at Sportpark SV Heeten. The course runs through the sports park and the woods around Schoonheten, with approximately 70 per cent unpaved terrain and gentle elevation changes. The routes offer green landscapes and wooded sections, and the prize winners are honoured in an annual ceremony after the race. The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a regular cross-country race in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the sports park and woods around Schoonheten
Approximately 70% unpaved terrain with gentle elevation changes
Green landscapes and wooded sections along the route
additional: The Midwintercross offers several distances. The 6 km and 10 km routes were revised in 2024. There is an annual prize-giving ceremony after the race. After the race, there is a prize-giving ceremony and a friendly atmosphere, with registration open to participants.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event management and sport, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to competition.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides phone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as assistance on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. Available information concerns the fifth edition, held on January 4, 2026; there are no confirmed details about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: 10 Bieg Trzech Króli
description: The Three Kings Run is a 5 km street race in Łódź, held to celebrate Epiphany. Participants start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the city streets, including Piotrkowska Street. It’s an opportunity to start the year actively and run in a festive atmosphere. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre route through the streets of Łódź
Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
The route includes Piotrkowska Street
additional: The sources refer to the 10th edition, held on 6 January 2026; they do not confirm a date of 5 January 2027.

name: Ultra CK Maraton
location: Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce, Poland
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a demanding ultra race of approximately 51 km with around 1,520 m of elevation gain, held in Kielce. The event also offers shorter races: Czarci Oddech, 15 km with 422 m of elevation gain, and the MTB cycling route Upiorna Trzydziestka, 30 km with 828 m of elevation gain. The event is aimed at enthusiasts of challenges and varied forms of sporting suffering, and is organized by the Świętokrzyskie Mountain Biking Association MTBCross Kielce. The start and race office are located at Hala Legionów in Kielce. Participants in the longest-distance race must carry mandatory safety equipment.
course_highlights: Piekielna Pętla: 51 km ultra race with around 1,520 m of elevation gain
Czarci Oddech: 15 km race with around 422 m of elevation gain
Upiorna Trzydziestka: 30 km MTB route with around 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2026 at Hala Legionów Kielce from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 6:00. The cutoff for all distances is 18:00/18:30. Mandatory equipment for ultra-race participants: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, identification, and clothing suitable for the weather. The race office is located at Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce. Participants in Piekielna Pętla are required to carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone. Details of the 2027 edition are not confirmed in the available information.

The event is open to various age and gender categories and also features a three-person team competition, with at least one woman on each team. The participant limit is 500, and the run is scheduled to start at 9:00.

6 km cross-country run and Nordic walking
Three-person teams may enter, with at least one woman on each team

A three-person team may be entered, and it must include at least one woman.

description: The 64th Wallenloop, organised by AV'56 in Goes, is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, 9 January 2027. The race attracts athletes from the region and offers a challenging course through the city of Goes. The organisers provide a sporting and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The Wallenloop is an important event on the Zeeland running calendar and is known for its good organisation and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the historic centre of Goes
Varied surfaces, including city roads
Atmospheric winter race in January

The organisers can be reached via the contact form on the website and by telephone during races at 0113-230788. Race categories range from 900 metres to 7,560 metres. Online registration is possible until a few days before the race; no on-site registration is mentioned.

name: Zandstuve Bosloop
description: The Zandstuve Forest Run is a challenging cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organised by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The event offers different distances for children and adults, in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap
Cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition

additional: On-the-day registration for individual participation is available until half an hour before the start at the Sportlust Vroomshoop clubhouse. Children run 1,500 metres (2 laps of 750 m), 5 km participants run 1 lap, and 10 km participants run 2 laps of 5 km. Prizes are awarded in all categories for the 5 km and 10 km, children receive medals for the 1.5 km, and Canicross participants receive a commemorative gift. Individual entrants can make a contribution to Landschap Overijssel. Distances: 1,500 m (children), 5 km, 10 km; advance and on-site registration; option to donate to Landschap Overijssel; prizes in various categories.

name: StardGRL
description: The Stard Grote Rivieren Running Circuit (StardGRL) is a running competition in the Drechtsteden region, consisting of nine running events spread throughout the year. The races take place in a variety of typical Dutch landscapes and range in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and standings are based on their best six performances from the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and sociable, with plenty of attention to personal goals and friendly rivalry.
course_highlights: Nine running events through typical Dutch landscapes
Distances range from 5 km to a half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances from nine races
additional: The competition consists of nine races, with standings based on the best six performances. Participants run in age categories and can register for the entire circuit. The races have an informal, sociable atmosphere, with an opportunity to chat and enjoy a drink afterwards. Information about the nine races, registration and standings is available; results are posted on uitslagen.nl

The event features children’s categories followed immediately by the main race. It is part of the Winter Running League and is suitable for the general public, including families with children. The start and registration are held in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, offering easy access and a friendly race atmosphere.

Part of the Winter Running League, with the race number valid for the entire series

A sense of community and support among local runners

The club promotes recreational running and brings the local running community together. For the 2025/2026 edition, race-day registration was open from 10:00 to 10:45, and races began at 11:00. These details have not been confirmed for the date of 10 January 2027.

name: XIII Bieg Zimowego Dziadka
description: The 13th Winter Grandpa Run is a friendly 10 km race held on the Kuchary Forest District running route. The route is fully marked and has restricted vehicle traffic, helping ensure participants’ safety. The time limit is 90 minutes. The event begins with a warm-up, followed by an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants after the race.
course_highlights: Kuchary Forest District running route
Fully marked 10 km course
Restricted vehicle traffic on the route
additional: Registration takes place from 10:00 to 10:30 on race day. There is a warm-up before the 10:30 start. The participant limit is 120. The awards ceremony and refreshments take place after the race, at around 12:30. Information available for the 13th edition relates to the race held on 11 January 2026; the entry fee was PLN 40 during registration and PLN 50 on the day of the event, and the participant limit was 120. It has not been confirmed whether these conditions will apply in 2027.

name: Zimowy Bieg Niedzwiedzia
location: Nowy Dębiec, Kościan County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kościanie
description: The Winter Bear Run in Nowy Dębiec is an annual running event organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a scenic setting. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The route runs through the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec
Scenic areas by the lake
Organized as part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix
additional: The event is organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix series. The resort has a swimming area, a beach and sports courts in Nowy Dębiec. Information about distances and routes is from the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Hulst by Lightrun
description: Hulst by Lightrun is a friendly running and walking event held in Hulst. It takes place on the third Friday evening of every month and offers a sociable atmosphere for participants of different levels. The route winds through Hulst’s charming streets, making it a unique experience for runners and walkers. It’s an accessible event that combines sport and conviviality.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes through Hulst’s charming streets
Friendly, relaxed atmosphere
Monthly event on the third Friday evening
additional: The event takes place on the third Friday evening of every month. It is an accessible running and walking event with a sociable atmosphere. A friendly running and walking event, held every third Friday evening.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, with woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills. Distances of 5 km and 9 km are available for different age categories, with timing provided without a chip. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit
additional: Maximum 300 participants per race. Timing without a chip. No showers or changing rooms available. Juniors run approximately 5 km; seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos will be published after the race. Course on unpaved paths; no showers or changing rooms; maximum 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest race in Klijndijk, organised from the Udik village hall. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes several hunebeds
Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area
additional: There is a €100 cash prize for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30.59 for men and 35.43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. The route passes hunebeds and includes forest and road sections. Registration is available in advance and on the day. Prizes are offered for breaking the course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organised by Atletiekvereniging Holten and part of the SNS CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37, in Holten. The varied course includes a few crossings over paved roads and a short stretch of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge. There is ample parking, first aid is available, and a speaker adds to the atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with a few crossings over paved roads
Around 500 metres of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge
Start and finish at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Ample parking, first aid and a speaker are available during the event. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes and includes a few crossings over paved roads and brick paving that can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities including registration at the MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid and sound equipment.

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: Zimní běh na Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on 16 January 2027. The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with significant climbs, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with cosy facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: The 19.9 km main race with 542 m of elevation gain over Velký and Malý Blaník
The 11.2 km accompanying race with 238 m of elevation gain and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations along the route in Býkovice and by the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the Načeradec Municipal Office building, approximately 270 m from the race facilities. Parking is available in several designated areas, marked with traffic signs and assisted by volunteer firefighters. The race is limited to 700 runners. The organisers offer free secure storage for valuables in the changing rooms at the primary school. The accompanying race starts at 10:45. The entry fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. In adverse circumstances, the race may be modified to individual starts or postponed. Online registration is available, with entry-fee refunds possible until 31.12.2026. The race takes place in January and has a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The route runs mostly along forest and field tracks. The main race starts at 10:10.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.

description: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race is a winter running festival held in Gdynia, offering six distances from 5 km to over 76 km. The courses pass through scenic areas with significant elevation gains, combining sporting competition with natural beauty and a unique atmosphere. The event is organized by the ULTRA WAY Foundation and features courses with checkpoints and aid stations, as well as professional timing and participant safety measures. It is an event for runners of varying experience levels who want to take on challenging courses and winter conditions.
course_highlights: Nocny Jeleń course – 76.6 km with +2309 m / -2313 m elevation change
Tropem Rysia course – 50 km with +1501 m / -1575 m elevation change
Courses with checkpoints and aid stations, and professional chip timing
additional: The start and finish of all races are located at the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium, ul. Kazimierza Górskiego 10. Buses take participants to the start of the longest distances from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre (paid transport; advance registration required). The time limit for completing the longest distance is 15 hours, and for the 50 km distance it is 11 hours. The DZIKI DUET race is run in pairs. Aid and hydration stations are available on the course (except on the shortest distances). The race has an ITRA 4 classification, UTMB 100K status, and 3 Mountain points.

name: 17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, organized since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on routes adapted to their age. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. The organizers also provide prizes for the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race pack includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The accompanying children’s races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. The race pack included a medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. This information refers to the previous edition.

description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place in scenic locations, with a particular focus on the visual appeal of the courses, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. The Łódź race is held in the Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Łódź
Scenic, attractive green surroundings
Courses suited to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. The events are cross-country races held in various locations in Wielkopolska and other cities. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th anniversary. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events. The Łódź editions also include children's races. The cited sources concern previous editions and do not confirm details of the event on January 16, 2027.

The start and finish are by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The races take place in January and are recreational and sporting in nature, with manual timekeeping and a commemorative medal for participants.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a good cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP through voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Everyone is welcome to take part and celebrate sport and helping others together.

Picturesque route in the spa town of Dąbki

In the previous edition, the donations collected were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

Competitors race over 6 km, 15 km, and 30 km courses (two laps of the 15 km loop). The event attracts cross-country skiing enthusiasts of all ages and also offers activities for children and families, such as dog-sled rides and a play zone. After the races, there is an awards ceremony and a quiz with prizes from sponsors. This sporting event has a unique atmosphere, combining competition with community spirit.

Underage competitors may enter only the 5 km and 15 km distances with written parental consent. On race day, registration is available at the race office at the airport in Nowy Targ. Results are sent by SMS to the phone number provided. Dog-sled rides and a play zone are available for children and families. A quiz with prizes from sponsors takes place after the awards ceremony. description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen featuring a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes run mostly along unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a woodland area of approximately 100 hectares. The start, refreshments and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The lap is just over 7 km, with six laps making up the full marathon. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Route mostly along unpaved paths in the Asserbos
Start, refreshments and finish at the AAC'61 athletics track
Lap of just over 7 km; six laps for the marathon
additional: You can register in advance via inschrijven.nl through 15 January, or on the day at the clubhouse, with card payment. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink. Changing rooms are available at the venue at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published afterwards on the club page. Unpaved paths, registration in advance and on the day, changing rooms available.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a series of three running races held in November, January and February around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer running distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1,000 metres on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km, starting at the same time as the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a canteen are also available. The race features official timing and a nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas.
course_highlights: Nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
A range of distances for beginner and experienced runners, including youth races on the track
additional: There is a 2-hour time limit for the walking distances. There is a drinks station on the track for participants in the 15 and 20 km races on their second lap. A free massage is available afterwards in the AAV'36 massage room (bring your own towel). Youth race keepsakes are free; other keepsakes and stamp cards for taking part in all three races are available for a fee. First aid is available on the track and course. The canteen is open and a limited number of lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers; course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas; traffic-free course; start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track; changing rooms and showers available; free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

name: Goedhart Drechtloop

The event offers several distances: a 1.4 km children’s run, 4 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht, offering a scenic and varied running experience in the Groene Hart.
course_highlights: Run through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude
Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Groene Hart
additional: The start and finish are on Beukenlaan in Leimuiden. The event runs from 11:00 to 14:00. Several distances are available, including a 1.4 km children’s run. The event is organized by S.V. Kickers ‘69. It takes place on 17 January 2027 from 11:00 to 14:00, with several running options and a convivial atmosphere for participants of all ages.

name: Leemkuilcross
